label: FP
reason: The vulnerable path involves a conditional assignment where the user-provided value (param) is only used if a mathematical condition is false. The condition (7*42 - num > 200) evaluates to (294 - 86 = 208 > 200), which is true, so the 'bar' variable is assigned the constant string 'This_should_always_happen' instead of the user-provided param. Therefore, the user-provided value does not actually reach the sink.

evidence.note: Conditional assignment uses a constant string instead of param
